uncited: *   **Input Geometry:** The parent geometry data is used to create the SDF.

Use only the closest and farthest intersections.
Voxels between intersections are marked inside; others outside.
*   **Laser Scan Mode (Off):** Send rays along primary axes.
Test each segment between pairs of intersections for inside/outside status.
